workflow: Manual consolidation of financial data from multiple ERP exports into Excel for variance analysis and reporting.
trigger: Monthly close period or quarterly reporting deadlines.
current_workaround: Users download CSV/Excel exports from various systems, write complex VBA macros or Python scripts to clean and merge the data, and manually verify line items against source documents. Many still rely on copy-pasting between disparate spreadsheets.
consequence: High risk of human error in data entry; significant time spent (often 2-3 days) on reconciliation rather than analysis; delayed reporting cycles.

workflow: Agile sprint tracking and status reporting across Jira, Confluence, and email.
trigger: End of sprint (bi-weekly) or weekly stakeholder updates.
current_workaround: Manually exporting Jira reports to Excel/CSV, formatting them in Google Sheets or PowerPoint, and emailing static PDFs to stakeholders who do not have Jira access. Maintaining a separate 'master' spreadsheet that is manually updated with Jira ticket statuses.
consequence: Data staleness (reports are never live); duplicate data entry errors; stakeholders complain about lack of real-time visibility; PM spends hours formatting rather than facilitating.

workflow: Candidate tracking and interview scheduling coordination.
trigger: Per candidate application or per interview round.
current_workaround: Using shared Google Sheets as an ATS (Applicant Tracking System) because native tools are too expensive or rigid. Manually emailing candidates and hiring managers to find time slots, then updating the sheet. Copying candidate details from LinkedIn/email into the sheet.
consequence: Missed emails due to manual tracking; scheduling conflicts; inability to scale recruitment efforts; high administrative burden on recruiters instead of sourcing.
